column1: # AUTHORED. Nodes placed by hand, overriding the solver.
# The layout is good at keeping edges radial and clouds apart, and it has no opinion
# about what a reader should notice. Where a node needs to sit somewhere for a reason
# the solver cannot know, say so here rather than tuning a constant until it happens:
# every constant is global, so moving one node by adjusting PROJECT_SWING or PAD moves
# all of them, and that has repeatedly cost more than it bought.
# angle_deg  bearing from the search node, degrees, anticlockwise from east. Blank keeps
# radius     distance from the search node, in points. Blank keeps the solved radius.
# reason     why, in a sentence. A pin with no reason is indistinguishable from a bug.
# A pinned node takes its cloud of samples with it. Pins are applied last, so they are
# not checked against anything: a pin can overlap a neighbour or put an edge through a
# cloud, and the run reports it rather than silently correcting it.
